reglesExercice.consigne: Memorize the question and answer. If you forget, the answer is revealed.

activites.question: When do we use the Present Simple?
activites.reponseAttendue: For habits, routines, general truths and permanent states. Ex: 'Water boils at 100°C.'
activites.explication: For habits, routines, general truths and permanent states. Ex: 'Water boils at 100°C.'

activites.question: When do we use the Present Continuous?
activites.reponseAttendue: For actions happening now, temporary situations, future arrangements. Ex: 'She is studying right now.'
activites.explication: For actions happening now, temporary situations, future arrangements. Ex: 'She is studying right now.'

activites.question: When do we use the Past Simple?
activites.reponseAttendue: For completed actions in the past with a known time. Ex: 'I visited N'Djamena last year.'
activites.explication: For completed actions in the past with a known time. Ex: 'I visited N'Djamena last year.'

activites.question: When do we use the Present Perfect?
activites.reponseAttendue: For past actions with a present result, or experiences (no specific time). Ex: 'I have finished my homework.'
activites.explication: For past actions with a present result, or experiences (no specific time). Ex: 'I have finished my homework.'

activites.question: What is the structure of Past Simple (regular)?
activites.reponseAttendue: Subject + verb-ed. Ex: 'He worked hard yesterday.'
activites.explication: Subject + verb-ed. Ex: 'He worked hard yesterday.'

activites.question: What is the structure of Present Perfect?
activites.reponseAttendue: Subject + have/has + past participle. Ex: 'They have studied all night.'
activites.explication: Subject + have/has + past participle. Ex: 'They have studied all night.'

activites.question: Difference: 'I lived in Chad' vs 'I have lived in Chad'?
activites.reponseAttendue: 'I lived' = completed (I don't live there anymore). 'I have lived' = still true now or recent.
activites.explication: 'I lived' = completed (I don't live there anymore). 'I have lived' = still true now or recent.

activites.question: When do we use the Past Continuous?
activites.reponseAttendue: For actions in progress at a specific past time, or background actions. Ex: 'I was reading when he called.'
activites.explication: For actions in progress at a specific past time, or background actions. Ex: 'I was reading when he called.'

activites.question: Give the past participle of: go, see, write, take
Give the past participle of: be, have, do, make
